data.attribution: Fanaee-T, H. (2013). Bike Sharing. UCI Machine Learning Repository.

resource_exception: All three indexes are measured as an explicit higher-capacity native-planner reference; construction and pages are recorded.
workloads: Real fixed dataset; generated query mixes. Current full workload and previous histogram are visible before each decision; future workload, latentphase and unselected measurements are not. Each block creates a fresh database so learning retains policy knowledge, not physical indexes.
cost: Native SQLITE_STMTSTATUS_VM_STEP for full CREATE INDEX plus every SELECT. Parsing, cloning, loading, validation, feature generation and inference are outside this work metric and are reported separately. No USD/energy/walltime-speed claim.
feedback: Delay 3..9 decisions; only selected cost and correctness evidence. Reward uses fixed public2M VM scale, never a hidden unselected reference cost. Receipts flushed in delivery order and scored at origin.
features: Raw=current3family histogram+previous3+querycount/32. Neural=raw+16pooled actualBrian2spike features from unchanged1024neuron circuit,20ms/frame. Declared128sensory input: histogram*.9+count*.25 for3groups of32; last32=count*.65. Onefixedneuralinitialization, intrinsic plasticity; sharedfeaturecomparison hasno outcome-dependent neuralcredit. Randomfeaturecomparator samedimensionality/rawinputs.
controls: Receipt-time controls deliberately use the wrong temporal context; they are defective-mechanism controls, not competitive baselines. Raw context UCB, training-calibratedstatic, domainfrequencyheuristic, frozenpolicy and all-indexreference remain visible.
analysis: Seed is paired inferential unit, Studentt95% interval over24reserved seeds per task. Report all tasks/methods; no cherry-picked winner. Full-period cost includes initial coverage and all profiling; late costs separately descriptive.

gates.correctness: Zero result mismatches and exact native batch audits
gates.benefit: Neural origin lower95 relative VM reduction vs noindex >0 on changing and recurrent
gates.credit: Neural origin lower95 relative reduction vs neuralreceipt-time >0 on changing and recurrent
gates.neural_specificity: Neural origin lower95 reductions vs raworigin AND randomfeatures >0 on all four tasks; otherwise no neural superiority claim
gates.stable: Neural origin upper95 relative regression vs trainingstatic below0.15 on stationary; report failure

limits: Not a new index-selection or UCB algorithm; UDO and SWIRL are prior art
Native measured-kernel replay with fresh-batch audits, not a deployed self-tuningproduction database
Workload schedules are generated over real data, not real user querylogs
VM work is not brain power, intelligence, energy or USD
No new TVB advantage, human-neuron fidelity, consciousness, token performance or paid vendor result
No private datasets, credentials, blockchain writes or production database mutation

development_search.selection: Lowest equal-task mean native work relative to no_index for neural_origin across only three development seeds; samechosenalphausedbyallmatchedridgebranches.
